Copy Anchor Link

@tailrocks/framerock/blocks/marketing/figures/figure-kit-22-block exports this block. The interactive preview above comes from apps/docs/src/stories/blocks/figure-kit-22-block.story.tsx.

API reference
Copy Anchor Link
Entry	Contract
Story arguments	`section: 'costs'
Fixture and callback wiring	The story exposes section (costs, traces, or quality) and variantId. The component selects one of the 22 source figures for that pair. The workbench offers three presets: costs with chart, traces with xray, and quality with review.
Registry item	block-marketing-figures-figure-kit-22. The portal payload is /r/block-marketing-figures-figure-kit-22.json.

Original design by Gustavo Fior (@gustavo-fior), gustavofior.com, and @heyimgustavo, with co-founder Abdul Haidar at Foglamp Labs (foglamp-labs/foglamp). The source project is licensed under Apache-2.0.

Eval Detail

Eval Detail presents an evaluation definition, scores, and related trace information in the dashboard shell. The story selects the support-quality evaluation fixture.

Flow Map

Flow Map lays out the scan graph in a chosen direction. The story supplies the scan graph fixture and resolves its favicons through ScanFaviconProvider.
